verdict.rationale: The evidence describes LM Studio only as a tool for downloading, running, and serving local models. Its API endpoints, MCP support, and RAG features are all framed around local models, and nothing documents connecting to cloud AI providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic in the same interface. The Bionic mention of running 'frontier open models' (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek) never says these are cloud-hosted, so it cannot be credited as cloud-provider integration.
